content: उपसंग्रह् €9 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To take upon oneself, experience, feel, suffer. .²2 To receive, accept. .²3 To seize, catch hold of; पाणिभ्यां तूपसंगृह्य <ls>Ms. 3. 224</ls>. .²4 To take into custody or possession. .²5 To win over, conciliate, make favourable; पिण्डदानादिनोपसंगृह्य <ls>Dk. 58</ls>. .²6 To clasp, embrace.
